# Milestone title

## Goal

_Describe the phase or bounded improvement and link its owning product scope or specifications._

## Scope and sequence

_Link the implementation issues and explain important dependencies or sequencing. Keep task acceptance criteria on the issues._

## Exit criteria

- [ ] _One verifiable milestone outcome._

## Evidence

_Link repository journals, experiments, and other evidence. Close the milestone only when its issues are closed and exit criteria are satisfied._
